name: Boy Scout Trail (Indian Cove to Keys West)
notes: The NPS says the Boy Scout Trail is about 7.8–8 miles one way and requires one of 14 designated sites in the high-use zone (the current export contains 17 numbered records, including two newer entries). Sites are ordered north-to-south from Indian Cove; several are short spurs, so selecting a site does not mean the route must visit every site.

name: California Riding and Hiking Trail
notes: The NPS management plan lists the CRHT at 37 miles one way. Outside the Boy Scout zone, Joshua Tree uses backcountry camping zones rather than fixed campsites; carry water and confirm the one-mile-from-road/500-foot-from-trail rules.

name: CRHT + Boy Scout Trail Extension
notes: Common winter/spring extension combining the CRHT with a designated Boy Scout site. Zone camping and water-cache logistics dominate; published trip reports vary widely in mileage.
